_readme: PAYMENT INSTRUCTIONS - ONE CENTRAL FILE
The bank details below are written here ONCE and are read by every page
that shows payment instructions. Change them here and they change
everywhere. Do not copy bank details into any page file.
TO UPDATE YOUR BANK DETAILS, edit the "bank" section below.
After editing, run build.cmd.
WHERE THESE DETAILS APPEAR
premium   Premium Resources page, for buying materials.
advert    Tuition & Course Promotions page, for advertising payments.
classes   RCF Online Academy, for class fees.
They are never shown on the homepage. A visitor sees them only after
choosing a paid product, an advertising package or a class.
WHAT THIS DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO
This website is a set of plain files with no server, so it cannot check
whether a bank transfer has arrived. Every payment is therefore verified
by a person. Nothing here asks for, stores or displays an online banking
password, a PIN, a one-time code, card details or an identity document
number, and nothing should ever be added that does.
THE AMOUNT FIELD
"amountLabel" is what visitors are told to pay. It is left as a plain
instruction rather than a figure, because prices are agreed case by
case. Put a real figure here when you are ready to publish one.
notice: Please verify that the account holder is shown as R. C. Fernando before completing the transfer. After payment, send the receipt through WhatsApp with your name, telephone number, and the product or advertising package purchased. Orders and advertisements are processed only after payment verification.
